title: Finite binary pullback refinement tree
statement: Let W be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] and let s a j:S a j → W be finitely many finite families covering W. Suppose chosen factorizations s a j = c a j followed by o a j have c closed and o open [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion], with quasi-compact o. Suppose q a j:Q a j → O a j is a quasi-compact open immersion whose image in W is range(o a j) minus range(s a j), and z a j:Z a j → W is a closed immersion with image the complement of range(o a j). Then there is a finite rooted binary tree of schemes numbered by Fin N, with root W, smaller parents, and quasi-compact quasi-separated immersed vertices. Internal vertices are split by complementary quasi-compact open and closed pullbacks [def-pc-fibre-product] of either (o,z), or (q,c) over a map to O. All leaf images are pairwise disjoint and cover W. Each nonempty leaf factors over W through some S a j of each family a.

source.place: Tag 09Y4, lemma-constructible-partition-refined-by-stratification; scheme-theoretic finite binary refinement bookkeeping in the item proof steps 6–9

proof.text: For each stratum replace a leaf T by the two pullbacks of O and Z, then split its open child by the pullbacks of Q and S. Scheme.Pullback.range_fst identifies the two pairs of ranges as complements. Base-change stability and qcqs permanence supply the vertex and edge properties. The two avoiding leaves miss the stratum; the third has its second projection as a factorization.

proof.text: Induct on the finite set of strata using bind, retaining avoidance or a factorization for every processed stratum by composition. On a nonempty final leaf pick a point; covering by each family supplies a stratum whose avoidance is impossible. Apply the numbering theorem to the resulting AllLeaves factorization predicate.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_refinement_tree
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace W] [QuasiSeparatedSpace W]
    (m : ℕ) (n : Fin m → ℕ)
    (S : ∀ a : Fin m, Fin (n a) → Scheme.{u})
    (s : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), S a j ⟶ W)
    (O Q Z : ∀ a : Fin m, Fin (n a) → Scheme.{u})
    (o : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), O a j ⟶ W)
    (c : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), S a j ⟶ O a j)
    (q : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), Q a j ⟶ O a j)
    (z : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), Z a j ⟶ W)
    (ho : ∀ a j, IsOpenImmersion (o a j))
    (hc : ∀ a j, IsClosedImmersion (c a j))
    (hq : ∀ a j, IsOpenImmersion (q a j))
    (hz : ∀ a j, IsClosedImmersion (z a j))
    (hco : ∀ a j, c a j ≫ o a j = s a j)
    (hcover : ∀ a : Fin m, (⋃ j : Fin (n a), Set.range (s a j).base) = Set.univ)
    (hoqc : ∀ a j, QuasiCompact (o a j))
    (hqqc : ∀ a j, QuasiCompact (q a j))
    (hqr : ∀ a j, Set.range (q a j ≫ o a j).base =
      Set.range (o a j).base \ Set.range (s a j).base)
    (hzr : ∀ a j, Set.range (z a j).base = (Set.range (o a j).base)ᶜ) :
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (V : Fin N → Scheme.{u}) (toW : ∀ v : Fin N, V v ⟶ W)
        (root : Fin N) (parent left right : Fin N → Fin N)
        (leftEdge : ∀ v : Fin N, V (left v) ⟶ V v)
        (rightEdge : ∀ v : Fin N, V (right v) ⟶ V v)
        (leaf : Fin N → Prop),
        (∃ e : V root ≅ W, e.hom = toW root) ∧ parent root = root ∧
        (∀ v, v ≠ root → (parent v).val < v.val) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v → leftEdge v ≫ toW v = toW (left v)) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v → rightEdge v ≫ toW v = toW (right v)) ∧
        (∀ v, CompactSpace (V v)) ∧
        (∀ v, QuasiSeparatedSpace (V v)) ∧
        (∀ v, IsImmersion (toW v)) ∧
        (∀ v, v ≠ root →
          left (parent v) = v ∨ right (parent v) = v) ∧
        (∀ v, leaf v ↔ ∀ w, w ≠ root → parent w ≠ v) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v → left v ≠ right v ∧
          v.val < (left v).val ∧ v.val < (right v).val ∧
          parent (left v) = v ∧ parent (right v) = v ∧
          IsOpenImmersion (leftEdge v) ∧
          IsClosedImmersion (rightEdge v) ∧
          QuasiCompact (leftEdge v) ∧ QuasiCompact (rightEdge v) ∧
          Set.range (leftEdge v).base ∪ Set.range (rightEdge v).base = Set.univ ∧
          Disjoint (Set.range (leftEdge v).base)
            (Set.range (rightEdge v).base)) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v →
          ∃ a : Fin m, ∃ j : Fin (n a),
            ((∃ h₁ : V (left v) = pullback (toW v) (o a j),
                ∃ h₂ : V (right v) = pullback (toW v) (z a j),
                leftEdge v = eqToHom h₁ ≫ pullback.fst (toW v) (o a j) ∧
                rightEdge v = eqToHom h₂ ≫ pullback.fst (toW v) (z a j)) ∨
             (∃ f : V v ⟶ O a j,
                f ≫ o a j = toW v ∧
                ∃ h₁ : V (left v) = pullback f (q a j),
                ∃ h₂ : V (right v) = pullback f (c a j),
                leftEdge v = eqToHom h₁ ≫ pullback.fst f (q a j) ∧
                rightEdge v = eqToHom h₂ ≫ pullback.fst f (c a j)))) ∧
        (∀ x : W, ∃ v : Fin N, leaf v ∧ Nonempty (V v) ∧
          x ∈ Set.range (toW v).base) ∧
        (∀ v w, leaf v → leaf w → v ≠ w →
          Disjoint (Set.range (toW v).base) (Set.range (toW w).base)) ∧
        (∀ v, leaf v → Nonempty (V v) →
          ∀ a : Fin m, ∃ j : Fin (n a), ∃ f : V v ⟶ S a j,
            f ≫ s a j = toW v)
